title: pyproject.toml Auditor
instructions: Implement `Issue`, `normalize`, `requirement_name` and `audit` in `pyproject_audit.py`. `audit(root)` reads `pyproject.toml` with `tomllib`, checks the `src/` layout on disk and returns `Issue`s sorted by code for rules PP001 to PP008. `Issue` must be a frozen, orderable dataclass, and invalid TOML must propagate `tomllib.TOMLDecodeError`.

evidence.label: A clean project returns no issues
Reports PP002 (no build-system) and PP003 (no requires-python)
Reports one PP004 per dev tool in runtime dependencies, ignoring look-alikes like pytest-cov
Reports PP005 for static plus dynamic version and PP006 for neither; dynamic-only is valid
Reports PP007 for script targets not of the form module.path:function
Reports PP008 for a missing src layout, using the normalised package name
normalize and requirement_name follow PEP 503 and reject nameless requirements
Issue is frozen and orderable, and audit returns issues sorted by code
